# aoa(cell, ko) (L1521–1581): W = Split(" " & cell & " "); per word, the first branch wins: dictRange is never Set, so the part-of-speech
# skip tests the word itself (only nonDecl works); a word in «ой» before a word that is not a lemma stays; from the 3rd word on, a word after
# arrPron stays; l­ <> word (not an abbreviation) → the adjective form; aaa (L1354) <> word → stays; else the noun form (ko 4/10 by the table;
# a consonant with an empty cell → the usual ending). Case restored by ·–— (L1350). Docs: docs/vba/analysis.md §3.0, §3 «Все что склоняется».
